guards: Library images and exports are served locally; imported projects cannot fetch arbitrary remote URLs or execute content.
Presentation changes never reinterpret or mutate saved anchors, rationales or candidate edges.
Project bundles retain the image, scene, settings, renderer/effect versions and paused frame; incompatible versions fail explicitly.
Geometric feature proposals and fictional labels are never presented as semantic detection or measured science.
Validate image dimensions, project size, coordinates, edge endpoints and presentation values before rendering.
Concurrent imports cannot replace an active project out of order; processed image caches cannot reuse another image.
Exported stills and recordings use the scene and presentation captured at export start.
Preserve saved scenes and renderer compatibility; describe changed effects and their limits.
Required checks run without credentials, and skipped checks are reported as skipped.
Agents never merge, approve, request changes or bypass branch protection.
Image styles use fixed pixel operations only; no model calls, tokens, authored masks or per-image agent styling decisions.
sources.description: Material failure modes of this repo.

guards: After three substantive reviewed revisions without convergence

checklist.question: Can uploads, imports, previews and exports stay local, with no remote image fetch or executable content accepted?
Do presentation edits select only saved nodes/edges and leave their meanings and coordinates unchanged?
Does save/open preserve image, scene, settings, versions and paused frame, rejecting incompatible versions?
Do labels and documentation distinguish agent observations, geometric proposals and fictional styling?
Do all image treatments remain fixed automatic pixel math with no inference, authored masks or per-image agent style decisions, preserving the selected light/dark effects?
Are malformed, oversized and unsafe scenes, images and settings rejected before rendering?
Are import/upload operations serialized, with image dimensions checked and effect caches invalidated?
Are PNG and video contents and filenames captured from the same immutable export selection?
Are original assets and checkpoint artifacts preserved, with the negative and dark-field behavior described honestly?
Do relevant credential-free checks execute with meaningful coverage, and are actual results distinguished from skipped checks?
Does the change preserve existing functionality and remain within scope, with no agent merge or post-SHIP cleanup?
